summary.text: Cindy Friedman is a Democratic state senator representing the 4th Middlesex District, in office since July 2017, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Before holding office she was a teacher and chief of staff to the late state Senator Kenneth Donnelly.

paragraphs.text: Cindy Friedman earned a bachelor's degree in education from Roger Williams University and a master's degree in special education from Lesley University.
Her professional experience includes serving as a kindergarten and elementary school teacher and as chief of staff for the late state Senator Kenneth Donnelly.
Friedman assumed office in the State Senate on July 27, 2017, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

In the 2025-2026 session she chaired the Steering and Policy Committee and the Joint Committee on Health Care Financing, and was vice chair of the Senate Rules Committee and the Joint Committee on Rules.
